title: Creation: log scrubber

creation.briefMd: scrub(input, output) writes unique trimmed names.

blocks.md:
## A tool you keep

`scrub(input, output)` reads UTF-8, writes unique trimmed sorted names to `output`. Use the same rules as the transfer lesson.

Print `ok` after writing `clean.txt` from `messy.txt`.
